profile.title: CSE Student & Full Stack Web Developer
profile.tagline: Computer Science & Engineering Undergrad building modern web apps.
profile.bio: Welcome to my portfolio! I am Anup, a Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) student and Full Stack Web Developer. Inspired by CodeWithHarry's mission of practical, project-based learning, I build modern web applications, master data structures, and share curated developer notes and projects.

projects.title: NeuralCode - AI Code Reviewer & Assistant
projects.description: Developer tool that performs static analysis, detects security vulnerabilities, and generates automated refactoring suggestions.

projects.title: StreamPulse - Video Streaming & Live Chat
projects.description: High-throughput video streaming platform with adaptive bitrate HLS transcoding, chat room websockets, and payment gateway.

notes.title: Python Complete Handwritten Master Notes
notes.description: Covers basics, loops, functions, OOP, decorators, generators, file handling, and top 50 interview questions.

notes.title: Ultimate Modern JavaScript (ES6 to ES2024)

notes.title: React 19 & Next.js Quick Architecture Cheatsheet
notes.description: Hooks cheat sheet, Server vs Client components, caching mechanisms, custom hooks, and state management recipes.

blogs.title: 10 Clean Code Principles Every Full Stack Developer Should Master
